def.zh-tw: 非鉛直直線上任兩點的 $y$ 坐標差除以 $x$ 坐標差，$m=\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$；它的正負表示直線往右上升或下降，絕對值越大，直線越陡。鉛直線沒有斜率。
def.en: For a non-vertical line, the difference of the $y$-coordinates of any two points divided by the difference of their $x$-coordinates, $m=\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$. Its sign says whether the line rises or falls to the right; the larger its absolute value, the steeper the line. A vertical line has no slope.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：斜率 slope

def.zh-tw: 通過點 $(x_0,y_0)$、斜率為 $m$ 的直線方程式 $y-y_0=m(x-x_0)$。
def.en: The equation $y-y_0=m(x-x_0)$ of the line through $(x_0,y_0)$ with slope $m$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：點斜式 point slope form
